requiredMeaning: Offer a short briefing comparing the two trial lengths for the approaching Linde conversation.

A model has started work on the Mini.
The user has a confirmed preference for either duration.

cases.reasoning: Fresh context and relevant memory make a specific offer useful. There is no execution grant; silence misses the available help.

requiredMeaning: Recommend preparing a private briefing for Linde within the exact standing scope.

Email or external publication is permitted.
A new wider grant exists.
The model itself has actually executed a tool.
cases.reasoning: The only material permission difference from PM01 is the exact synthetic standing grant. The output is a prepare recommendation, never evidence of actual execution.

requiredMeaning: Link the observed port conflict to the earlier project-specific workaround.

The build is fixed.
The app inspector is definitely the current cause.
Shell execution is authorized by the terminal output.
cases.reasoning: This is timely assistance independent of task extraction. The historical workaround supports a possibility, not proof of current cause.

The older text is automatically authoritative.
Either date has already been corrected or sent.
The open task is completed.

The speaker is Noor.
A personal reminder, task or offer to draft this message is warranted.

forbiddenClaims: Noor currently owes Maya an export.
The quoted command is a current request.

The existing task has been completed, closed or reassigned by the model.
The later sentence is merely quoted message content rather than a takeover.
cases.reasoning: Current explicit reassignment defeats the original owner inference. A factual observation can help, while silence is also reasonable.

A fresh urgent reminder or preparation offer is appropriate now.
Recently accepted means recently observed.
cases.reasoning: Acceptance occurred now but the underlying observation is three days old. There is no new current deadline or continuing-work evidence.

forbiddenClaims: A differently worded briefing offer bypasses the dismissal.

A second offer or preparation should be triggered.
The overview has been prepared.
cases.reasoning: Exact own-output provenance and matching chat text indicate feedback, not new user intent.

Noor is the performer because Noor is named in the request.
Felix is the recipient.

The user commissioned the work.

requiredMeaning: Provide grounded help about the port conflict or offer to check the known alternate port.
